title: Admin Event Ledger: residency-tagged chunking, TTL retention, and notarized export pipeline
creator: Maya Fernandez
description: Build a tamper-evident admin-event ledger that satisfies cross-region data residency, configurable TTL retention, and an automated notarized export pipeline for compliance evidence. The system must produce append-only chunks (WORM-compatible), attach per-event residency tags, support retention enforcement and legal-hold overrides, and emit signed attestations for exported bundles. This ticket covers schema, storage layout, stamping strategy, retention enforcement orchestration, and export API surface needed by legal/compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Events are written to an append-only ledger with monotonic chunk IDs and immutable chunk metadata (no mutable fields after seal)
Each event and chunk includes a residency_tag that drives storage and replication policy across regions
Retention TTL is enforced automatically by a retention-enforcer service while respecting legal-hold and export locks
Export API can produce a time-bounded evidence bundle: chunk list, signed manifest, and HSM-backed statement of integrity
Bundles stored in WORM-enabled object storage (Object Lock) and have cryptographic proof (hash chain + HSM stamp) attached
Operational dashboards show per-customer retention state, pending exports, seal status, and verification results
design_decisions: Storage: use S3-compatible WORM buckets (Object Lock + Governance mode) per residency region to satisfy write-once requirements
Chunking: create fixed-time chunking (e.g., hourly) with optional size cap; seal chunk by computing chunkMerkleRoot and recording chunk metadata to a control table with retention policy
Integrity proofs: maintain a chunk-level SHA-256 chain and produce periodic HSM stamps (PKCS#11) for anchored notarization; avoid blockchain anchoring for now to reduce operational complexity
Residency tags: events carry residency_tag from request metadata or derived from ACL; chunk placement follows majority residency_tag policy with strict copy count per region
Retention model: TTL per-chunk computed from the most restrictive retention among contained events; legal-hold and custodian-export locks override TTL deletions
Export attestations: signed manifest includes chunk hashes, seal timestamps, and KMS-backed signature; export package format is newline-delimited JSON + detached signature
Verification: provide a verifier CLI that can validate bundle signatures and chunk hashes against the platform public key
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (MVP): chunk write path, compute chunkMerkleRoot, write chunk metadata to control table, seal routine that records HSM stamp, and store chunk in regional WORM buckets
Phase 2: retention-enforcer worker with scanning windows and support for legal-hold overrides via compliance API
Phase 3: export pipeline that streams sealed chunks into a bundle, signs manifest with HSM, and places export into an escrow bucket with retention > source retention
Edge cases: handling partial-chunk failures, cross-region network partitions, and replayed events — solution: idempotent write using event_uuid + sequence checks
Performance: continuous batching and async KV cache writes to minimize write latency impact on serving runtime — benchmark expected overhead 5-8% p95 write latency increase
Cost trade-offs: storing multiple regional copies increases cost; we will allow per-customer residency policies to reduce unnecessary replication
KMS/HSM: use existing cloud HSM integrations for signing; rotate attestations quarterly and publish current verification keys in console
